title: Senior Presales - Digital Native Industry
description:
Join us as we scale our business by building on our tremendous success around the world. The massive database market is going to double over the next few years and TiDB is a global player positioned as a major disruptor with TiDB Database and Database as a Service offering. TiDB is the proven enterprise database foundation for the AI era. We help companies solve today’s database problems. Cost, scale, downtime, and complexity. With a distributed SQL architecture that is already battle-tested at enterprise scale. And now we help those same companies future-proof for innovating with AI, by giving them one unified foundation for transactional state, vector context, real-time analytics, and safe agent operations. In a world where AI agents need to work on fresh data, act safely, and scale economically, TiDB is not another database add-on. It is the highway system for agentic workloads. Large and high-growth organizations in markets as varied as financial services, logistics, gaming, e-commerce and software as a service have successfully deployed and expanded their TiDB footprint on mission-critical applications. Our strong open-source community roots (40,000+ stars on GitHub), innovative products and inclusive culture draw passionate and dedicated people to our company. Learn more about TiDB careers and join our team to be at the forefront of innovation and growth.

Role Overview

You have the rare combination of technical savviness and business acumen and you’re looking for a career where you can utilize both as a Solutions Architect/Presales at PingCAP, you will hone each of these skills by advising a diverse set of customers on what is possible using TiDB.
 
We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect/Presales to join our dynamic team. The Solution Architect/Presales will be responsible for designing and implementing innovative solutions to meet our clients' business needs. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate complex concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 
PingCAP’s Presales are empowered to come up with creative solutions on the spot so we are looking for someone willing to challenge the status quo and throw out the manual on occasion. We welcome candidates with an entrepreneurial mindset to work together with our talented team. Be prepared to roll up your sleeves, remain flexible, and hit the ground running with a go-getter mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Educate prospects and customers on what is possible with TiDB and share best practices for integrating into their applications
  • Understand customer requirements and communicate the business value of solving technology problems using TiDB
  • Guide the design and deployment of hybrid transactional and analytical databases that impact multiple functional areas of a customer’s organization
  • Work on RFPs / customer’s technical requirements with the Sales team
  • Prepare demos and proofs-of-concept to demonstrate various use cases for TiDB
  • Create technical content to show customers how to integrate TiDB or implement best practices for new technologies
  • During a customer's implementation, assist backend developers, database administrators, product managers, and project owners with any and all technical questions that arise
  • Document the architectural solutions that customers have designed and deployed
  • Distill and communicate customer needs and product feedback to Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales
  • Public speaking by participating in physical or online events

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect or similar role, with a minimum of 2-5 years of experience in solution design and implementation
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong technical proficiency in a wide range of technologies, including but not limited to cloud computing, micro services architecture, API design, database systems, and security principles.
  • A strong Database experience is preferred. MySQL experience is most preferred.
  • A strong understanding of the software development lifecycle;

We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. Come advance with us! In keeping with our values, no employee or applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. TiDB also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our organization. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at TiDB.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a high-energy, AI-native GTM & Sales Ops Associate to become the analytical and operational backbone of our North America business. This is not a traditional ops role where you move data between spreadsheets. Half of this job is helping the region see clearly, where the market is going, and where the next dollar should go. The other half is building the machine that runs on those answers, the data, the systems, the automations, the incentives. The ideal candidate understands that the future of operations is automated. You don't wait for a tool, you build the workflow. You have a "vibe coding" mentality, using LLMs and low-code tools to close the gap between "we need this" and "it's done."

Responsibilities:

  • North America Market & GTM Analysis: Build the outside-in view of our North America go-to-market (the market, the competition, the buyers) and read it alongside what our own deals are telling us. Turn that into recommendations that give regional leadership a sharper basis for their calls.
  • Pipeline & Forecast Analytics: Own pipeline and forecast analytics, and run a forecast cadence leadership can trust. Don't just build dashboards, tell us what the data means, and bring a recommended fix along with the finding.
  • AI-Native Systems & Automation: Build on our sales tech stack rather than just administering it. Wire LLMs and low-code tools into the daily workflow so repetitive work stops being manual.
  • Compensation & Incentives: Manage and calculate sales commission plans, accurate, on time, and clear enough that the team trusts the number.
  • Data Foundation & CRM Integrity: Own the "source of truth." Keep our sales data clean and trustworthy enough that both people and AI agents can rely on it.
  • Global Coordination: Bridge time zones. Keep North America leadership and global HQ aligned on strategy, numbers, and priorities.We're a lean team in a fast-moving region, so the exact mix of these will shift over time, we're looking for someone who's comfortable with that.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 2–4 years in Sales Ops, RevOps, GTM/Business Strategy, market or competitive research, consulting, or another highly analytical role.
  • Analytical Depth: You can get from raw data to a defensible recommendation on your own, and you stay useful when the internal sample is small and the answer has to come from outside research.
  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and Mandarin is preferred. You will work directly with the North America field team and with global HQ, and you'll be the one making sure both sides actually understand each other.
  • The AI-Native Mindset: You are a power user of Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini. You don't do manual work if an API or an automation can do it better.
  • Vibe Coding Familiarity: You may not be a software engineer, but you know how to prompt, use Claude Code / Cursor, or use natural language to build internal tools and automate the boring parts.

Salary Range:

The annual anticipated base salary range for U.S. candidates for this role is USD $80K to $130K. Four zones are applied with different levels of the pay range. More details of the Geo Differential Pay Policy will be discussed during the HR conversation. The actual individual base pay will depend on various factors such as the complexity and responsibility of the role, work locations, job levels, and relevant experience and skills. This role is also eligible to participate in TiDB's Bonus and Equity Plan, as well as our Sales Compensation Plan if it is a sales role. In order to comply with local legislation and provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges on all US job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Please note that actual salaries may vary and fall outside of this range depending on factors such as a candidate's qualifications, geographic location, skills, experience, and competencies. Other benefits include health insurance, flexible vacation time, paid holidays, and parental leave. Salaries for candidates outside the U.S. will vary based on local compensation structures.
